title: feat(collapsable widgets): add collapsable and collapsed option
body:
Demo:

![demo](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/13190726/48f59176-d75f-11e5-95c1-00bbed3e7b0c.gif)

All `header` capable widgets are now collapsable aware.

New options:
- collapsable: Hide the widget body and footer when clicking on header
- collapsed: Initialize the widget in collapsed state

This also adds:
- ais-root generic css class
- ais-body generic css class

To be in par with already existing ais-header, ais-footer.

This also adds:
- ais-root__collapsable css class
- ais-root__collapsed css class

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @redox, @Jerskouille and @pixelastic to be potential reviewers
On Google, you get more results with `collapsible` than with `collapsable` (and my spellchecking reports a typo :))

> On Google, you get more results with collapsible than with collapsable (and my spellchecking reports a typo :))

Indeed! We may need to find better semantics here because it's not very clean/easy to say "collapsible"

In Bootstrap documentation and other similar plugins they say `collapse,` `collapsing`, `collapsed` and `collapsible`. http://getbootstrap.com/javascript/#collapse-example-accordion

I think `collapse` is pretty good verb as it really shows what it is for compared to `hide`, `slide up`, `accordion` or something else.
implemented `collapsible: { collapsed: true }` mapped on showMore, thanks all for review!
